# bundle remove drops an asset from musher.yaml by ID
mkdir project
cd project

exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle init --yes
stderr 'Created musher.yaml'

# remove one of the scaffolded assets
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle remove code-review --yes
stderr 'Removed'

# the remaining bundle should still be valid
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle validate
stderr 'Bundle is valid'
